Scenario fixture: rgaa-frame-title-relevant (RGAA 2.2.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form ftr_case_NN. Each frame with a non-empty title is asked about, quoting the title. A frame with no title or an empty one fails 2.1.1 instead.

A. Titled frames, for a person (CANTTELL)

01 — CANTTELL: title that names the content
02 — CANTTELL: title that names nothing

B. Out of scope

03 — NOT APPLICABLE: no title (2.1.1)
04 — NOT APPLICABLE: blank title (2.1.1)
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: hidden with aria-hidden
